justification: Thesis is stated in the closing paragraph ('what an older learner takes up may matter far less than whether they keep at it'); A/D overclaim, B is off-frame (childhood).
'modest ones, on the order of a few percent' + 'gains were still there ... three months later'; C contradicts 'a little under three hours a week'.
'they had climbed by roughly the same margin as the cellists''; A/B invert the finding, C contradicts 'never so much as held an instrument'.

'a fixed weekly commitment, a room full of other people ... labor of getting better at something genuinely hard'; A is refuted by the book-club result, C overclaims 'fully accounted for', D is not in the text.
Writer calls it 'a lovely idea', concedes Pellerham 'may well turn out to be right', then lands on 'somewhere more sober' — reserved, not convinced/dismissive/optimistic.

'Endast vid de ängar som låg närmare än hundra meter från lampraden ökade fjärilsbesöken påtagligt; längre bort gick ingen förändring att mäta.' B overstates ('oavsett avståndet'), A reverses cause and effect, C is refuted (bin är dagaktiva).

'En stark armatur intill ängen överröstar detta ljusband och får insekterna att cirkla planlöst kring lyktan'; the text explicitly denies fright ('inte ljuset i sig som skrämmer dem'), so C is out; B/D are not in the text.

The article pairs the cheap practical measure ('Att släcka eller rikta om enstaka lyktor kostar föga') with the limits (distance, weather, single landscape). A/D are sub-findings, B overclaims far past the text's own caution.

Only the plots within 100 m changed, so the more distant meadows were evidently not much affected by the lighting to begin with. A ('saknade helt') and C are unsupported; D contradicts the measured result.

Para 5: 'Endast vid de ängar som låg närmare än hundra meter från lampraden ökade fjärilsbesöken påtagligt; längre bort gick ingen förändring att mäta.' D states exactly this. A is refuted (frösättningen steg med en femtedel), B overstates the magnitude (~en tredjedel, not more than double), C is refuted (honungsbina 'berördes inte alls').

Para 6: moths steer by 'det svaga ljusbandet vid horisonten' and 'En stark armatur intill ängen överröstar detta ljusband och får insekterna att cirkla planlöst kring lyktan'. C is explicitly denied ('inte ljuset i sig som skrämmer dem'); B (burnt/blind eyes) and D (scent lost in lamplight) appear nowhere in the text.

The whole-text arc: a cheap measure that works ('kostar föga', kommuner hör av sig) held against explicit limits (only within 100 m, weather-dependent, one landscape only). A and D are single details, not the main point; B overclaims in the exact direction the article's caution paragraph rejects.

Inference from the 100 m threshold plus the stated mechanism (a strong armature 'intill ängen' drowns the himlarand): beyond 100 m the lamps were evidently not drowning the cue, so darkening changed nothing. A invents a low baseline abundance the text never gives, C contradicts 'honungsbina berördes inte alls' and their day-activity, D contradicts the measured null result.
